messages:
elaine: Quick post-GA sync — we got three recurring signals from customers: 1) tail latency spikes on long chat sessions, 2) intermittent streaming cutoff for tokens >1024, 3) snippet markdown rendering issues. Need to decide sprint slicing: bugs vs polish for the next 2 weeks. Suggested: P0: latency hotfix (dedicated batching tweak + kernel fallback), P1: streaming retry/backpressure fix, Enhs: snippet UX + onboarding flows + rate-limit messaging. Thoughts?

omar: I can take latency hotfix. Need logs & perf traces. Can someone confirm which customers and repro session IDs?

sophie: I'll own reproduction matrix. Found one repro: session 0a9f on prod-xy, p99 CPU/GPU context switch correlated. Pushing test plan now.

maria: Snippet UI: I sketched 2 quick fixes — 1) preserve code block languages, 2) collapse long snippets with copy button. Link: https://figma.com/file/abcd-snippets

kevin: SRE: p99 spike looks like batching fallback kicking in when KV cache misses >40%. We can mitigate with a server-side prefix cache hotfix (low risk). If we do that first, should reduce costs too. Recommend canary to 10% traffic.

elaine: Decision proposal: sprint week1: P0 latency hotfix canary at 10% (omar + kevin). Week1 end: evaluate metrics; if stable, promote. Week2: P1 streaming fix (sophie + eng-runtime). Enhs go to grooming backlog with acceptance criteria and deps (maria + PM). Any blockers for rollout window?

omar: No blockers. I'll need a small runtime patch. ETA for canary by Tue EOD.

sophie: QA will run regression sweep on Tue + Wed, adding two automated tests: `stream_resume_after_disconnect` and `prefix_cache_consistency`.

maria: For snippet polish, I propose we scope to "preserve language meta + copy" for this sprint; defer collapsible groups to next cycle.

elaine: OK locking scope: 1 P0 hotfix (canary Tue 10%), 1 P1 streaming (week2), 2 small enhs scoped. I'll create tickets now:
- INF-2101 (P0 latency hotfix) https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2101
- INF-2102 (Streaming retry/backpressure) https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2102
- INF-2103 (Snippet preserve & copy) https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2103

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: INF-2101 -> canary-10% at 2026-03-24T15:00Z :rocket:

kevin: I'll set alert: delta p99 > 10% over baseline triggers rollback. Also add trace sampling to capture KV miss context.

omar: Patch pushed to branch `hotfix/inf-2101-latency`; PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/891

sophie: QA note: add flaky tolerance to streaming test until backpressure fix lands, will mark test `quarantine` and attach logs.

elaine: Great. Next sync Thu 10am to review canary metrics and decide promote/roll back. If promote, schedule infra patch for dedicated pools.

maria: I'll add a short release note + screenshots for INF-2103.

elaine: Thanks all — updating roadmap and customer comms now. :thumbsup:
